note: recorded response: asked for the nivolumab-monotherapy arm PFS, returned the combination arm value; the quote names all three arms
provenance: verbatim raw model response recorded by the Phase 6E melanoma run (glm-4.5-flash); frozen here as a regression fixture

response.quote: The median progression-free survival was 6.9 months (95% confidence interval [CI], 4.3 to 9.5) in the nivolumab group, 11.5 months (95% CI, 8.9 to 16.7) in the nivolumab-plus-ipilimumab group, and 2.9 months (95% CI, 2.8 to 3.4) in the ipilimumab group.
